issues: What level of procedural fairness is required when a federal decision-maker cancels or revokes a licence?
Whether the decision-maker was required to provide the licensee an opportunity to respond to the allegations before making the decision
Whether the decision-maker was required to provide reasons for the decision to cancel the licence
The standard of review applicable to a determination of whether procedural fairness was observed
Whether the absence of a hearing and reasons can be cured after the fact or renders the decision a nullity
The appropriate remedy on judicial review where procedural fairness has been breached (setting aside, remand, or other relief)
key_facts: no opportunity to respond to allegations
causes_of_action: judicial review of a federal administrative decision for breach of procedural fairness
